question_record.context: As part of a recent security incident, a user named gsmith was observed hiding a known public tool under an unusual filename. Concurrently, there was suspicious Task Scheduler activity, which might indicate an attempt to launch malicious code automatically and establish persistence. The earlier process related to this incident had the ProcessId__CreatedTimeUtc__CommandLine `5752__2024-07-06t00:00:01.7155092z__iy2orr1e.rrg.exe -windowstyle hidden -encodedcommand qwa6afwauwbjahiaaqbwahqacwbcaeuaeabwag8acgb0aeearabgafmavabvagsazqbuafmaaqbnag4aaqbuaemazqbyahqalgbwahmamqa=`.
question_record.question: What is the ProcessId__CreatedTimeUtc__CommandLine value related to the suspicious Task Scheduler activity?
solution: The hostname `mb-adfs` was involved in an incident where a known dual-purpose tool was observed under an unexpected filename on 2024-07-06.

A suspicious Task Scheduler activity was detected where the process with Process ID `6808`, running `powershell.exe -encodedcommand qwa6afwauwbjahiaaqbwahqacwbcafiazqbu....` was created on 2024-07-02 at 09:48:12.7628138Z. This may be an attempt to launch malicious code automatically and establish persistence.

68.name: Attempt to hide use of dual-purpose tool
68.description:
A known public tool, which could also be used for malicious reasons, was observed under an unexpected filename.
This might be an attempt to hide the usage of that tool for malicious purposes.

33.name: Suspicious Task Scheduler activity
33.description:
A process involved in earlier malicious activity used Task Scheduler to create, modify, or delete a task. This might be an attempt launch malicious code automatically and establish persistence.

For further information on this threat, read the following threat analytics report: https://security.microsoft.com/threatanalytics3/c9709a39-ac8d-493d-9a63-71da3ca1e745/analystreport

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID' AND o.Concept = 'Host_Name'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
